# Philosophy Schools | Stoicism, Africana, Islamic, Analytic & More

> Explore philosophy schools with verified English quotes—Stoicism, Existentialism, Confucianism, Daoism, Africana Philosophy, Islamic Philosophy, Analytic Philosophy, Kyoto School, and more.

Enter through a tradition, then follow thinkers and themes.

### [Stoicism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/stoicism)

Virtue, nature, and the discipline of judgment.

Seneca · Epictetus · Marcus

### [Existentialism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/existentialism)

Freedom, responsibility, absurdity, and authentic choice.

Sartre · Beauvoir · Camus

### [Confucianism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/confucianism)

Humaneness, ritual, learning, and cultivated roles.

Confucius · Mencius · Xunzi

### [Daoism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/daoism)

The Dao, wuwei, and naturalness without forced order.

Laozi · Zhuangzi

### [Rationalism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/rationalism)

Reason, a priori insight, and systematic metaphysics.

Descartes · Spinoza · Leibniz

### [Empiricism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/empiricism)

Experience as the primary source of ideas and evidence.

Locke · Berkeley · Hume

### [Pragmatism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/pragmatism)

Meaning, truth, and inquiry tied to practical consequences.

Peirce · James · Dewey

### [Africana Philosophy](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/africana-philosophy)

Critique, conceptual decolonization, and diaspora thought.

Wiredu · Hountondji · Fanon · Appiah

### [Islamic Philosophy](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/islamic-philosophy)

Falsafa: intellect, prophecy, and demonstrative science.

Avicenna · Averroes · al-Farabi

### [Analytic Philosophy](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/analytic-philosophy)

Clarity, logic, language, intention, and mind.

Wittgenstein · Anscombe · Foot

### [Neo-Confucianism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/neo-confucianism)

Principle, heart-mind, and the unity of knowledge and action.

Zhu Xi · Wang Yangming

### [Platonism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/platonism)

Forms, the Good, and dialectic as education of desire.

Plato · later Platonic lineages

### [Kyoto School](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/kyoto-school)

Absolute nothingness, experience, and religious worldview.

Nishida · Nishitani

### [German Idealism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/german-idealism)

Freedom, spirit, and systematic post-Kantian reason.

Hegel · related idealists

### [Jewish Rationalism](https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/jewish-rationalism)

Reason, revelation, law, and negative theology.

Maimonides · Saadia Gaon
